title: OSHWA Certified since 2024!
content:
**RSC is OSHWA Certified!** 🎉

Being OSHWA-certified means I'm part of a growing global movement to make hardware accessible, adaptable, and open to all. 💡🌍

The [**Open Source Hardware Association**](https://oshwa.org/) certification recognises my commitment to openness in hardware development. This includes:

- **Commitment to Open Source Principles**
- **Transparency and Accessibility**
- **Global Recognition and Trust**
- **Fostering Collaboration and Innovation**

**More about OSHWA:** [certification.oshwa.org](https://certification.oshwa.org/)

**My certification details:** [(UID EE000003)](https://certification.oshwa.org/ee000003.html)
